description: Structure du trait de côte et identification des ouvrages de défense contre la mer du département de la Manche is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by maps.rolnp.fr. Definition of the structure of the coastline corresponding to the level of the leash of the highest, waters on the coast of the Department of the English Channel. Identification of defence structures against the sea. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Structure of the coastline and identification of defence structures against the sea of the Department of the English Cha" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include ROLNP, ouvrage de défense contre la mer, digue, trait de côte, DDTM50. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
